name: quantumreadiness
description: An adaptive post-quantum readiness scanner, local and offline: it closes operations against a catalogue of their documented spellings, each with a test, says which (operation, ecosystem) pairs are closed, and carries its coverage and limits inside the CBOM. A maintainer tool in the repository proposes new spellings, which enter only with a source and a test.

plugins.description: An adaptive post-quantum readiness scanner.
